verdict: Exact production camera board, lens and FFC CANNOT DETERMINE; sourced modules are candidates only

identity.sensor: IMX219 verified in official bring-up log for that tested board, not a manufacturing BOM guarantee
identity.rotation_behavior: Current main.rs default90 describes clockwise mounting; mount metadata is sent to display consumer. In-pipeline rotation off by default. Historical180 applies to alpha bring-up entry, not a universal installed orientation.
identity.optics: Official press kit still calls camera resolution and field of view provisional; no focal length or exact lens MPN established. Community62deg and B0183 supplier75deg are not original evidence.
identity.official_photo: Viewed official-product.jpg: front lens visible within coloured eye ring; no readable barrel/board marking, hidden rear PCB and FFC. No measurement scale; cannot establish focal length or module revision.

mesh.scope: Existing out/verify/mech_dims.json measurements reused. Holder is not camera PCB outline; barrel bounding dimensions do not determine optics or aperture fit.

comparison.size_basis: Supplier structured description comparison table, third product column; not 25 x 24. Includes mounting assembly; bare PCB drawing not independently resolved.
comparison.connectors: Both 15 and 22 pin CSI ports; same connector count alone does not prove pin mapping/contact-side compatibility
comparison.lens: No lens in package; M12 and CS holders supplied; focal length/FOV depend on selected lens
comparison.included_cables: 15 pin 125 mm FFC  plus 22 pin 150 mm FFC per supplier package description
comparison.stock: In stock; quantity and volume lead time unknown
comparison.fit_status: Not the 25 x 24 mm-class module suggested by B6 RFQ. No measured head fit; sensor match insufficient. Prices exclude added lens and any selected adapter.

ffc.host: Radxa ZERO3 documents22pin CSI and support for Pi CameraV2/IMX219. This does not establish compatibility of every IMX219 module.
ffc.local_length_observation: wiring/CABLES.md row 20 uses Radxa centroid to camera site 13.3 mm with 15 mm rounded cut. These are not measured connector exits, service loop or bend radius; 15 mm is not an original ribbon length or validated manufacturable route.

routes.type: Pi Zero camera adapter cable; exact contact-side/pin-map proof for selected module still required
routes.stock: In stock, no numeric quantity observed
Dynamic variant status not verified in this pass; historical offer not promoted current

required_measurements: Both connector part numbers, pin1 orientation, pitch, latch side, contact face and insertion depth
Full continuity/pin assignment including grounds, data lanes, clock, I2C, reset/power; position count is insufficient
Installed route between connector exits, minimum bend radius, folds, flex thickness/stiffeners and slack; validate without altering head CAD
One bench capture on exact board/FFC/module/kernel combination; active crop and rotation documented

correction_proposals: B6 Seeed 102110719 is38x38x16mm module withoutlens per its own description; do not score it as a25x24mm drop-in
B6 B0183 does not lock cable bundle or revision across vendors. Current UCTRONICS lens replacement restriction contradicts interchangeable-lens assumption
B8 centroid/site 13.3 mm and15mm cut are routing proxies, not actual original FFC or connector-to-connector route
ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE mounting/rotation statement needs current90deg metadata behavior distinguished from alpha180deg historical report
